name: autosheet-mcp
description: Run Autosheet agents in Google Sheets to clean, transform, enrich, and analyze spreadsheet data.

interface.longDescription:
Run Autosheet agents in Google Sheets to clean, transform, enrich, and analyze spreadsheet data.

Point an agent at a Google Sheets spreadsheet and describe the work in plain language: fill a column with sentiment, categories, translations, summaries, or scores; clean, validate, or deduplicate rows; classify or analyze data; extract and transform cell contents; or copy a tab between spreadsheets. Follow up on the same agent to refine the result, check progress on a long run, or stop it.

Requirements: connect your Autosheet account and sign in with Google to grant access to the spreadsheets you want the agent to work on. Agent runs consume Autosheet account usage.
defaultPrompt: Clean and standardize the data in my Google Sheet.
Analyze my spreadsheet and summarize the findings.
Continue the work with my existing Autosheet agent.
